Limitations

LLMs provide free-text answers that can be different from the format provided in the instructions.

This
expands previous findings on the limitations of LLMs on reasoning tasks [49, 13, 20].

Moreover, while being able to perform some causal reasoning tasks
successfully [28], notably on commonsense causal reasoning [23, 54], LLMs have shown limitations
on tasks that require robust reasoning, such as arithmetic tasks in unfamiliar settings [49], or abstract
reasoning [13].

Acknowledging this limitation,
alternative approaches have been proposed using LLMs to extract causal relationships from text
[43, 40].
